breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states the design requirement as 'P_cr ≥ n·P' (critical load must be greater than or equal to the applied load multiplied by the factor of safety). It does not repeat the incorrect condition 'P_cr ≥ P/n' from the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth prompt's requirement.
